## LOAD FUNCTIONS
```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(tidyr)
##require(quantileCI)

load_data <- function(results_path, techs, probs, skip_coldstart, idletimes) {
  technique <- c()
  tailLatencyProb <- c()
  idletime <- c()
  p50 <- c()
  p95 <- c()
  p99 <- c()
  p999 <- c()
  p9999 <- c()
  for (scs in skip_coldstart) {
    for (t in techs) {
      for (p in probs) {
        for (i in idletimes) {
          fileName = paste(paste(t, i, p, scs, sep = "_"), "invocations.csv", sep="-")
          results = read.csv(paste(results_path, t, fileName, sep="/"), header = TRUE)
    
          results_treated <- select(
            transform(
              results, 
              minResponseTime = pmin(responseTime, techniqueResponseTime)
            ),
            responseTime,
            techniqueResponseTime,
            minResponseTime
          )
  
          results_treated$responseTimeUseful <- ifelse(
            results_treated$minResponseTime != 0,
            results_treated$minResponseTime,
            results_treated$responseTime
          )
    
          technique <- c(technique, t)
          tailLatencyProb <- c(tailLatencyProb, p)
          idletime <- c(idletime, i)
          p50 <- c(p50, quantile(results_treated$responseTimeUseful, probs = 0.5))
          p95 <- c(p95, quantile(results_treated$responseTimeUseful, probs = 0.95))
          p99 <- c(p99, quantile(results_treated$responseTimeUseful, probs = 0.99))
          p999 <- c(p999, quantile(results_treated$responseTimeUseful, probs = 0.999))
          p9999 <- c(p9999, quantile(results_treated$responseTimeUseful, probs = 0.9999))
        }
      }
    }
  }

  df_for_invocations <- data.frame(technique, tailLatencyProb, idletime, p50, p95, p99, p999, p9999)

  uptime <- c()
  busyTime <- c()
  replicasCount <- c()
  for (scs in skip_coldstart) {
    for (t in techs) {
      for (p in probs) {
        for (i in idletimes) {
          fileName = paste(paste(t, i, p, scs, sep = "_"), "replicas.csv", sep="-")
          results = read.csv(paste(results_path, t, fileName, sep="/"), header = TRUE)
          uptime <- c(uptime, sum(results$upTime))
          busyTime <- c(busyTime, sum(results$busyTime))
          replicasCount <- c(replicasCount, nrow(results))
        }
      }
    }
  }
  df_for_replicas <- data.frame(technique, tailLatencyProb, idletime, uptime, busyTime, replicasCount)
  return(list(df_for_invocations = df_for_invocations, df_for_replicas = df_for_replicas))
}

parse_values <- function(df) {
  df <- df %>% mutate(tailLatencyProb = ifelse(tailLatencyProb == "tlprobp95", 95, tailLatencyProb))
  df <- df %>% mutate(tailLatencyProb = ifelse(tailLatencyProb == "tlprobp99", 99, tailLatencyProb))
  df <- df %>% mutate(tailLatencyProb = ifelse(tailLatencyProb == "tlprobp999", 999, tailLatencyProb))
  df <- df %>% mutate(tailLatencyProb = ifelse(tailLatencyProb == "tlprobp9999", 9999, tailLatencyProb))

  df <- df %>% mutate(idletime = ifelse(idletime == "idletime0.0", 0, idletime))
  df <- df %>% mutate(idletime = ifelse(idletime == "idletime15.0", 15, idletime))
  df <- df %>% mutate(idletime = ifelse(idletime == "idletimeINF", Inf, idletime))

  return(df)
}

plot_results <- function(df, metric, y_label, title) {
  df$idletime_f <- factor(df$idletime, levels = c(0, 15, Inf))
  ggplot(df, aes(x=tailLatencyProb, y=metric, color=as.factor(technique), shape=as.factor(technique))) +
    geom_jitter(width = 0.015, height = 0, alpha = 0.8, size = 2.5, stroke = 1) +
    facet_grid(. ~ factor(idletime, levels = c(0, 15, Inf))) +
    labs(x = "tail latency probability", y = y_label, title = title, colour = "technique", shape = "technique") +
    scale_shape_manual(values = c(1, 23, 24, 15)) +
    scale_color_manual(values = c("red", "purple", "blue", "limegreen")) +  # cores mais distintas
    theme_bw() +
    theme(
      legend.position = "bottom",
      strip.text = element_text(size = 12),
      axis.text = element_text(size = 10)
    )
}

ecdf_plot <- function(title, data, xinf, xsup, yinf, ysup, linetype=c("solid", "dotted", "dotdash", "dashed"), cols=c(15, 195, 150), img_name=FALSE) {
    vanilla.color <- "limegreen"
    vanilla.p95 <- quantile(data$vanilla, 0.95)
    vanilla.p999 <- quantile(data$vanilla, 0.999)
    vanilla.p50 <- quantile(data$vanilla, 0.5)

    rh.color <- "purple"
    rh.p95 <- quantile(data$rh, 0.95)
    rh.p999 <- quantile(data$rh, 0.999)
    rh.p50 <- quantile(data$rh, 0.5)
    
    rho.color <- "blue"
    rho.p95 <- quantile(data$rho, 0.95)
    rho.p999 <- quantile(data$rho, 0.999)
    rho.p50 <- quantile(data$rho, 0.5)

    gci.color <- "red"
    gci.p95 <- quantile(data$gci, 0.95)
    gci.p999 <- quantile(data$gci, 0.999)
    gci.p50 <- quantile(data$gci, 0.5)

    # Definindo alturas diferentes para cada grupo
    vanilla_y = 0.9
    rh_y = 0.1
    rho_y = 0.7
    gci_y = 0.4
    
    size = 0.5
    alpha = 0.8
    angle = 90
    
    p <- data[, colSums(is.na(data)) != nrow(data)] %>%
    pivot_longer(everything()) %>%
    group_by(name) %>%
    arrange(value, by_group = TRUE) %>%
    mutate(ecdf = seq(1/n(), 1 - 1/n(), length.out = n())) %>%
    ggplot(aes(x = value, y = ecdf, colour=name, linetype=name)) +
    xlim(xinf, xsup) +
    ylim(yinf, ysup) +
    geom_step() +
    theme(text=element_text(size=12), plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5))+
    theme(legend.text=element_text(size=12)) +
    theme(legend.position="top") +

    scale_color_manual(values=c("vanilla"="limegreen", "rh"="purple", "rho"="blue", "gci"="red")) +
    scale_fill_manual(values=hcl(100, 65, alpha=c(1, 1, 1, 1))) +
    scale_linetype_manual(values=c("vanilla"="solid", "rh"="dotted", "rho"="dotdash", "gci"="dashed")) +
    labs(x="Response Time (ms)",y="ECDF", color="scenario", linetype="scenario") +
    ggtitle(title) +

    # Vanilla annotations - todos na mesma altura do grupo vanilla
    annotate(geom="text", x=vanilla.p50, y=vanilla_y, label="Median", angle=angle, color=vanilla.color) +
    geom_vline(xintercept=vanilla.p50, linetype="solid", size=size, alpha=alpha, color=vanilla.color) +
    annotate(geom="text", x=vanilla.p95, y=vanilla_y, label="95th", angle=angle, color=vanilla.color) +
    geom_vline(xintercept=vanilla.p95, linetype="solid", size=size, alpha=alpha, color=vanilla.color) +
    annotate(geom="text", x=vanilla.p999, y=vanilla_y, label="99.9th", angle=angle, color=vanilla.color) +
    geom_vline(xintercept=vanilla.p999, linetype="solid", size=size, alpha=alpha, color=vanilla.color) +

    # RH annotations - todos na mesma altura do grupo rh
    annotate(geom="text", x=rh.p50, y=rh_y, label="Median", angle=angle, color=rh.color) +
    geom_vline(xintercept=rh.p50, linetype="dotted", size=size, alpha=alpha, color=rh.color) +
    annotate(geom="text", x=rh.p95, y=rh_y, label="95th", angle=angle, color=rh.color) +
    geom_vline(xintercept=rh.p95, linetype="dotted", size=size, alpha=alpha, color=rh.color) +
    annotate(geom="text", x=rh.p999, y=rh_y, label="99.9th", angle=angle, color=rh.color) +
    geom_vline(xintercept=rh.p999, linetype="dotted", size=size, alpha=alpha, color=rh.color) +

    # RHO annotations - todos na mesma altura do grupo rho
    annotate(geom="text", x=rho.p50, y=rho_y, label="Median", angle=angle, color=rho.color) +
    geom_vline(xintercept=rho.p50, linetype="dotdash", size=size, alpha=alpha, color=rho.color) +
    annotate(geom="text", x=rho.p95, y=rho_y, label="95th", angle=angle, color=rho.color) +
    geom_vline(xintercept=rho.p95, linetype="dotdash", size=size, alpha=alpha, color=rho.color) +
    annotate(geom="text", x=rho.p999, y=rho_y, label="99.9th", angle=angle, color=rho.color) +
    geom_vline(xintercept=rho.p999, linetype="dotdash", size=size, alpha=alpha, color=rho.color) +

    # GCI annotations - todos na mesma altura do grupo gci
    annotate(geom="text", x=gci.p50, y=gci_y, label="Median", angle=angle, color=gci.color) +
    geom_vline(xintercept=gci.p50, linetype="dashed", size=size, alpha=alpha, color=gci.color) +
    annotate(geom="text", x=gci.p95, y=gci_y, label="95th", angle=angle, color=gci.color) +
    geom_vline(xintercept=gci.p95, linetype="dashed", size=size, alpha=alpha, color=gci.color) +
    annotate(geom="text", x=gci.p999, y=gci_y, label="99.9th", angle=angle, color=gci.color) +
    geom_vline(xintercept=gci.p999, linetype="dashed", size=size, alpha=alpha, color=gci.color) +

    theme_bw()
        
    if (img_name != FALSE) {
      ggsave(img_name, width=10, height=5)
    }
    print(p)
}

boxplot_plot <- function(title, df_a, df_b, df_c, df_d, yrange, outliershape = NA) {
  return(ggplot(rbind(df_a, df_b, df_c, df_d), aes(x=scenario, y=responseTime, fill=scenario)) +
  geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = outliershape) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("red", "purple", "blue", "limegreen")) +
  coord_cartesian(ylim=yrange) + 
  theme(text=element_text(size=15)) +
  theme(legend.text=element_text(size=15)) +
  labs(x = "scenario", y = "latency (ms)") +
  theme(axis.ticks.x = element_blank(), axis.text.x = element_blank(), axis.title.x = element_blank(), plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5)) +
  theme_bw() +
  ggtitle(title)
  )
}

replicas_alive_plot <- function(data, scenario_col = "scenario", title = "Replicas Active") {
  data$time_readable <- as.POSIXct(data$timestamp, origin = "2021-01-31", tz = "UTC")
  data[[scenario_col]] <- factor(
    data[[scenario_col]],
    levels = c("gci", "rh", "rho", "vanilla")
  )
  
  ggplot(data, aes(x = time_readable, y = replica_amount, color = !!sym(scenario_col))) +
    geom_line(size = 0.5) +
    geom_point(size = 0.5) +
    scale_color_manual(values=c("vanilla"="limegreen", "rh"="purple", "rho"="blue", "gci"="red")) +
    scale_fill_manual(values=hcl(100, 65, alpha=c(1, 1, 1, 1))) +
    scale_linetype_manual(values=c("vanilla"="solid", "rh"="dotted", "rho"="dotdash", "gci"="dashed")) +
    scale_x_datetime(
      date_labels = "%d %b\n%H:%M",   # e.g. "01 Jan\n12:00"
      date_breaks = "2 days"          # tick every 2 days
    ) +
    labs(
      title = title,
      x = "Time (2-week window)",
      y = "Amount of Alive Replicas",
      color = "scenario"
    ) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold"),
      legend.position = "top"
    )
}

plot_requests_workload <- function(data, bin_size = "10 min", title = "Requests Over Time") {
  data$time_readable <- as.POSIXct(data$target_timestamp, origin = "2021-01-31", tz = "UTC")
  binned_data <- data %>%
    mutate(bin_time = cut(time_readable, breaks = bin_size)) %>%
    group_by(bin_time) %>%
    summarise(requests = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
    mutate(bin_time = as.POSIXct(bin_time, tz = "UTC"))

  ggplot(binned_data, aes(x = bin_time, y = requests)) +
    geom_line(color = "steelblue", size = 1) +
    geom_point(color = "steelblue", size = 1) +
    scale_x_datetime(
      date_labels = "%d %b\n%H:%M",
      date_breaks = "2 days"
    ) +
    labs(
      title = title,
      x = "Time (2-week window)",
      y = "Amount of Invocations"
    ) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold"),
      legend.position = "none"
    )
}
```

## LOAD DATA RESUMING ALL SIMULATION SCENARIOS
```{r}
results_path <- "/Users/davidquaresma/Desktop/repos/faas-simulator/results_generator"
#results_path <- "/Users/davidquaresma/Desktop/repos/faas-simulator/results_azure"
techs <- c('GCI', 'Vanilla', 'RequestHedgingDefault', 'RequestHedgingOpt')
probs <- c('tlprobp95', 'tlprobp99')
skipColdStarts <- c('skipColdStarttrue', 'skipColdStartfalse')
idletimes <- c('idletimeINF', 'idletime0.0', 'idletime15.0')

data_loaded <- load_data(results_path, techs, probs, skipColdStarts, idletimes)
df_for_invocations <- data_loaded$df_for_invocations
df_for_replicas <- data_loaded$df_for_replicas

df_for_invocations_bkp = df_for_invocations
df_for_replicas_bkp = df_for_replicas
df_for_invocations <- parse_values(df_for_invocations)
df_for_replicas <- parse_values(df_for_replicas)

invoc_data = filter(df_for_invocations, technique != "")
repl_data = filter(df_for_replicas, technique != "")
```
